race.comment: THINKING SENSATION (4) launched into this campaign with a dominant win at Coleraine in this grade. The fell a lip shy from making it two on the bounce here last time. Fit and firing. DESIGNS OF EIGHT (10) wound up strongly last time out to finish one length adrift in second over this track and trip when resuming. Better for that and and doesn't need to improve a great deal here to be winning. AKA DAKA (5) is knocking on the door and clearly appreciates theses conditions. Peaking now and gets a key switch in Allen. Have to take seriously. NO GREATER VUE (7) settled well back from a wide draw last time then wound up strongly to finish fifth over 1500m at this track. Gets the chance to settle closer this time and looms as one of the key chances.
